attributions.surface_quote: absolute Unity cannot pass to Infinity... that Unity would cease to be one.

canonical_statement: The universe manifests through the periodical expansion and contraction of an inherent potency.

attributions.surface_quote: inherent radiation... expands itself into the manifested Universe.

canonical_statement: Space is the absolute container of all existence, functioning as both void and plenum depending on the level of perception.

attributions.surface_quote: Space is neither a 'limitless void,' nor a 'conditioned fulness,' but both.

canonical_statement: The death of a creator deity signifies only a temporary withdrawal from the manifested plane of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: temporary disappearance from the manifested plane of existence, or as a periodical rest.

canonical_statement: All manifested entities are simply potencies or expressions of infinite space.

attributions.surface_quote: all in this Universe are simply the Potencies

canonical_statement: The universe originates from, exists within, and returns to an unmanifested absolute principle.

attributions.surface_quote: the Universe lives in, proceeds from, and will return to, Brahma

canonical_statement: Space is the eternal, self-existent, and absolute reality that persists independently of the existence of universes or deities.

attributions.surface_quote: What is that which was, is, and will be... Space

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is structured in seven distinct layers or gradations of differentiation.

attributions.surface_quote: From its undifferentiated to its differentiated surface it is composed of seven layers.

canonical_statement: Force and matter are inseparable potencies inherent to the nature of space.

attributions.surface_quote: Force and Matter, as Potencies of Space, inseparable

canonical_statement: Divine revelation originates from finite, manifested entities rather than the unmanifestable absolute.

attributions.surface_quote: revelation as coming from divine yet still finite Beings

canonical_statement: The primordial root of matter is an eternal, undifferentiated substance that acts as a veil over absolute reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Mulaprakriti is a sort of veil thrown over Parabrahman.

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is subject to cyclical periods of existence known as Mahamanvantaras.

attributions.surface_quote: existence so long as it lasts, to wit, for one Mahamanvantara.

canonical_statement: Eternal space is the fundamental substrate that persists through all states of being.

attributions.surface_quote: What is it that ever is? — Space, the eternal.

canonical_statement: The creative process of the universe is driven by a rhythmic, breath-like expansion and contraction.

attributions.surface_quote: What is it that is ever coming and going? — The Great Breath.

canonical_statement: All exoteric religious traditions share a single, unified esoteric foundation.

attributions.surface_quote: the esoteric root or foundation is one.

canonical_statement: Matter is dual in its unmanifested and manifested states, and septenary in its structural composition.

attributions.surface_quote: Matter is dual in religious metaphysics, and in esoteric teachings septenary.

canonical_statement: Ultimate reality is a singular, non-dual, infinite substrate often identified as Space.

attributions.surface_quote: The three are one... and this is Space.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes periodic cycles of manifestation (Manvantara) and dissolution (Pralaya).

attributions.surface_quote: This produces the periods of Evolution and Dissolution, Manvantara and Pralaya.

canonical_statement: The creative process functions through the rhythmic expansion and contraction of cosmic energy.

attributions.surface_quote: It expands and contracts (exhalation and inhalation).

canonical_statement: Finite objects and organized forms are illusory (Maya) because they are compound and temporary.

attributions.surface_quote: Esoteric Philosophy, regarding every finite thing as Maya.

canonical_statement: The universe consists of seven cosmic elements, only some of which are currently perceptible to humans.

attributions.surface_quote: Occult Science recognizes seven Cosmic Elements.

canonical_statement: Individual atoms contain the inherent creative energy of the divine Breath.

attributions.surface_quote: Every atom being said to contain in itself the creative energy.

canonical_statement: All physical elements are conditional modifications of a single, primordial, universal substrate.

attributions.surface_quote: seven Elements... are simply conditional modifications and aspects of the One and only Element.

canonical_statement: The manifest universe undergoes periodic cycles of evolution and dissolution following a state of non-existence.

attributions.surface_quote: alternate eras of evolution and dissolution.

canonical_statement: Human cognitive capacity is limited, rendering the ultimate nature of the Universal Kosmos beyond current comprehension.

attributions.surface_quote: secret teachings... could not be understood by even the highest minds in this age.

canonical_statement: Akasha is the fifth universal cosmic principle, serving as the source of human intellect and the soul of the world.

attributions.surface_quote: Akasha... the Fifth universal cosmic Principle... is, cosmically, a radiant... plastic matter.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an immutable, boundless principle that transcends human conception and language.

attributions.surface_quote: An Omnipresent, Eternal, Boundless and Immutable Principle, on which all speculation is impossible.

canonical_statement: An absolute, unconditioned reality exists prior to and independent of all manifested existence.

attributions.surface_quote: One Absolute Reality which antecedes all manifested, conditioned Being.

canonical_statement: The absolute reality is characterized by two fundamental aspects: absolute abstract space and absolute abstract motion.

attributions.surface_quote: This Be-ness is symbolized in the Secret Doctrine under two aspects: absolute Abstract Space... and absolute Abstract Motion.

canonical_statement: Consciousness is inherently linked to change, which is represented by the principle of motion.

attributions.surface_quote: Consciousness is inconceivable to us apart from change, and motion best symbolizes change.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an impersonal, absolute consciousness that transcends all conditioned existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Parabrahman, the One Reality, is the field of Absolute Consciousness.

canonical_statement: Duality arises from the Absolute through the interaction of Spirit and Matter.

attributions.surface_quote: duality supervenes in the contrast of Spirit and Matter, Subject and Object.

canonical_statement: Spirit and Matter are not independent entities but are dual aspects of the singular Absolute.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit and Matter are... the two symbols or aspects of the Absolute.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness requires a material vehicle to manifest as a self-aware subject.

attributions.surface_quote: it is only through a vehicle of matter that consciousness wells up as I am I.

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is dependent upon the interplay between cosmic ideation and cosmic substance.

attributions.surface_quote: the contrast of these two aspects of the Absolute is essential to the existence of the Manifested Universe.

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is fundamentally defined by the duality of subject and object, spirit and matter.

attributions.surface_quote: The Manifested Universe, therefore, is pervaded by duality

canonical_statement: Spirit and matter are synthesized within a singular, underlying unity.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit and Matter, are but aspects of the One Unity

canonical_statement: Fohat acts as the dynamic link or bridge between divine ideation and cosmic substance.

attributions.surface_quote: Fohat is the bridge by which Ideas are impressed on Cosmic Substance

canonical_statement: Individualized consciousness arises from the interaction between cosmic ideation and material vehicles.

attributions.surface_quote: from Spirit comes our Consciousness, from Cosmic Substance the several Vehicles

canonical_statement: The universe is eternal in its totality, undergoing periodic cycles of manifestation and dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: The Eternity of the Universe in toto as a boundless plane

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an absolute that encompasses both being and non-being.

attributions.surface_quote: The One Reality, Sat, which is both Absolute Being and Non-Being

canonical_statement: The universe operates through a fundamental, universal law of periodicity, characterized by cycles of manifestation and withdrawal.

attributions.surface_quote: The appearance and disappearance of Worlds is like a regular tidal ebb of flux.

canonical_statement: Individual souls are fundamentally identical to the Universal Over-Soul, originating from an unknown root essence.

attributions.surface_quote: The fundamental identity of all Souls with the Universal OverSoul.

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution requires the soul to pass through all elemental forms of the phenomenal world to acquire individuality.

attributions.surface_quote: No spiritual soul can have independent existence before passing through every elemental form.

canonical_statement: Individual spiritual status is determined solely by self-induced effort and merit accumulated through successive incarnations.

attributions.surface_quote: No privileges in man, save those won by his own Ego through personal effort.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a singular, undifferentiated essence that manifests as all cosmic and micro-cosmic phenomena.

attributions.surface_quote: Brahman is in every atom of the universe, the only Reality.

canonical_statement: The manifested phenomenal world is an illusory appearance derived from a singular, eternal, and unconditioned reality.

attributions.surface_quote: manifested phenomenal and temporary appearance, it is no better than an evanescent illusion

canonical_statement: The ultimate principle of existence is sexless, unconditioned, and eternal in its absolute state.

attributions.surface_quote: In its absoluteness, the One Principle... is sexless, unconditioned and eternal.

canonical_statement: Cosmic manifestation proceeds through a series of androgynous emanations that differentiate into male and female principles at lower levels.

attributions.surface_quote: Its periodical manvantaric emanation... is also One, androgynous and phenomenally finite.

canonical_statement: The fundamental creative forces of the universe are abstract metaphysical qualities of formation, preservation, and destruction.

attributions.surface_quote: three metaphysical abstract qualities of Formation, Preservation, and Destruction

canonical_statement: During minor cosmic cycles of dissolution, physical worlds remain in a static, preserved state rather than being annihilated.

attributions.surface_quote: during the Minor Pralayas... the planets remain intact, though dead

canonical_statement: Personalized deities are illusory projections resulting from the limited, egotistical human consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: god or the aggregate gods are regarded... as false appearances

canonical_statement: The Supreme Reality consists of three primary aspects: Spirit, Prakriti (matter/nature), and Time.

attributions.surface_quote: Brahma... has essentially the aspect of Prakriti... Spirit and the aspect of Time.

canonical_statement: The initial state of the universe is represented by a point within a circle, symbolizing the root of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: the sacred symbolism represents it as a perfect Circle with the Point in the centre.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an unknowable, infinite power that persists unchanging in quantity while constantly changing in form.

attributions.surface_quote: that which persists unchanging in quantity, but ever changing in form... is an unknown power

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a singular, unified totality that transcends all linguistic and conceptual categorization.

attributions.surface_quote: the One All, and the One All in All.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is inherently limited to a specific plane of existence, rendering higher states incomprehensible.

attributions.surface_quote: consciousness is limited to the plane of existence next to that.

canonical_statement: Cosmic evolution follows a universal, recurring abstract formula applicable to all scales of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: abstract algebraical formula of that evolution.

canonical_statement: The primordial state of the absolute prior to manifestation is beyond descriptive language and can only be symbolized.

attributions.surface_quote: such a state can only be symbolized; to describe it is impossible.

canonical_statement: The Absolute state is beyond positive description and can only be defined through the negation of abstract attributes.

attributions.surface_quote: state of Absoluteness per se, it can possess none of those specific attributes

canonical_statement: Metaphysical truths are apprehended through intuitive faculties rather than the physical brain.

attributions.surface_quote: all these Stanzas appeal to the inner faculties rather than to the ordinary comprehension

canonical_statement: The Monad is a universal unit of existence applicable to both solar systems and atoms.

attributions.surface_quote: term Monad being one which may apply equally to the vastest Solar System or atom

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is governed by a hierarchy of conscious divine powers acting as agents of the One Supreme Energy.

attributions.surface_quote: Septenary Hierarchy of conscious Divine Powers, which are the active manifestations of the One

canonical_statement: Natural laws are the externalized manifestations of the One Law, administered by intelligent divine beings.

attributions.surface_quote: embodying in themselves those manifestations of the One Law, which we know as Laws

canonical_statement: The physical universe evolves through the condensation of cosmic matter into structured planetary and solar systems.

attributions.surface_quote: First, diffused Cosmic Matter, then the Fiery Whirlwind... forms a Solar Universe

canonical_statement: The evolution of human consciousness occurs in cyclical stages known as Rounds.

attributions.surface_quote: The development of Mau from his first appearance on this earth in this Round.

canonical_statement: Metaphysical truths are categorized by levels of initiation, rendering them incomprehensible to the uninitiated.

attributions.surface_quote: Were they published complete they would remain incomprehensible to all save a few high Occultists.

canonical_statement: Humanity progresses through distinct developmental stages referred to as Root-Races.

attributions.surface_quote: Sanskrit... pertain to the Fifth Root-Race.

canonical_statement: Metaphysical truths are expressed through symbolic representations rather than literal historical accounts.

attributions.surface_quote: Mahabharatan period are not found in the Vedas, nor are they to be met with.

canonical_statement: Esoteric knowledge possesses a philosophical validity comparable to or exceeding empirical scientific hypotheses.

attributions.surface_quote: It is not in any sense less scientific than are many of the so-called scientific theories.

canonical_statement: Prior to manifestation, there exists a singular, undifferentiated state of being that transcends duality and existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Nor Aught nor Nought existed; the only One breathed breathless by Itself.

canonical_statement: Time is a cyclical phenomenon that ceases to exist during periods of cosmic dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: Time was not, for it lay asleep in the infinite Bosom of Duration.

canonical_statement: The individual essence persists unchanged through the cycles of cosmic creation and destruction.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou shalt be still as thou wert before and know no change.

canonical_statement: The universe emerges from a state of absolute potentiality through a process of rhythmic outbreathing.

attributions.surface_quote: The Universe, the Son of Necessity, was immersed in Paranishpanna, to be outbreathed.

canonical_statement: Universal consciousness and individual agency are dependent upon the existence of differentiated entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Universal Mind was not, for there were no Ah-hi to contain it.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a state of non-being that precedes all causal existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The Visible that was, and the Invisible that is, rested in Eternal Non-Being.

canonical_statement: Universal life exists as an unconscious pulsation within an infinite, causeless substrate.

attributions.surface_quote: Life pulsated unconscious in Universal Space, throughout that All-Presence.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of the universe is a self-unaware, eternal process of becoming.

attributions.surface_quote: Ceaseless Eternal Breath, which knows itself not.

canonical_statement: Form arises from a primordial, formless root of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The Producers of Form from No-Form — the Root of the World.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an undifferentiated, absolute state of darkness that precedes all manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness alone was Father-Mother, Svabhavat.

canonical_statement: The universe originates from a singular, latent germ contained within the divine consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The Universe was still concealed in the Divine Thought.

canonical_statement: Manifestation occurs through the differentiation of a singular essence into a structured plurality of forces.

attributions.surface_quote: The Radiant Essence becomes Seven inside, Seven outside.

canonical_statement: The fundamental unity of existence persists despite the appearance of multiplicity and differentiation.

attributions.surface_quote: The Root remains, the Light remains, the Curds remain, and still Oeaohoo is One.

canonical_statement: The process of creation is a cyclical expansion from an internal, latent state to an external, manifest state.

attributions.surface_quote: The Mother swells, expanding from within without.

canonical_statement: The universe is a web spun from the duality of Spirit and Matter, unified in the substance of Svabhavat.

attributions.surface_quote: Father-Mother spin a Web... the Universe, spun out of the Two Substances made in One.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes periodic cycles of expansion and contraction, returning to unity at the end of a cycle.

attributions.surface_quote: It expands when the Breath of Fire is upon it; it contracts when the Breath of the Mother touches it.

canonical_statement: Individual entities are reflections of the Self-Existent Lord, each functioning as a microcosm of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Each is a part of the Web. Reflecting the Self-Existent Lord, each becomes in turn a World.

canonical_statement: All existence is a manifestation of a singular, non-dual source, often described as 'No-Number'.

attributions.surface_quote: There is neither first nor last; for all is One Number, issued from No-Number.

canonical_statement: The material world is an illusion created by the exclusion of the higher spiritual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: He shuts out the Above, and leaves the Below to be seen as the Great Illusion.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a boundless, undifferentiated unity that precedes all numerical manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: The Oi-Ha-Hou, which is Darkness, the Boundless, or the No-Number.

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is constructed through the interaction of primordial numerical and geometric archetypes.

attributions.surface_quote: These are called Spheres, Triangles, Cubes, Lines and Modellers.

canonical_statement: A mediating force, Fohat, acts as the bridge between divine thought and the formation of physical matter.

attributions.surface_quote: Fohat is the Steed, and the Thought is the Rider.

canonical_statement: The universe is organized into hierarchical regions and dimensions governed by specific spiritual entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Seven Regions above, and the Seven below.

canonical_statement: The physical world is a reflection or shadow of a higher, formless divine reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The Divine Arupa reflects itself in Chhaya Loka.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured by a hierarchical progression of emanations originating from a singular source of light.

attributions.surface_quote: from One Light, Seven Lights; from each of the Seven, seven times Seven Lights.

canonical_statement: The physical universe is anchored by eternal, immutable centers of force that persist throughout cosmic cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: The Swift and the Radiant One produces the seven Laya Centres... seats the Universe on these Eternal Foundations.

canonical_statement: Life and motion are infused into material forms by an active, energetic force acting upon primordial matter.

attributions.surface_quote: He collects the Fiery-Dust... infusing life thereunto, then sets them into motion.

canonical_statement: The evolution of consciousness and form involves a cycle of conflict between creative and destructive forces within space.

attributions.surface_quote: Battles fought between the Creators and the Destroyers, and Battles fought for Space.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of existence is a collective reunion described as the Great Day 'Be With Us'.

attributions.surface_quote: progressing towards the Great Day 'Be With Us.'

canonical_statement: The manifestation of reality occurs through a sequential process where aspects of the whole are revealed while others remain concealed.

attributions.surface_quote: Of the Seven— first One manifested. Six concealed

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is an extension of a singular, primordial life-force that persists through all material forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Life precedes Form, and Life survives the last atom.

canonical_statement: The individual soul is a temporary manifestation of a higher divine source, to which it will eventually return.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art myself, my image and my shadow... thou shalt re-become myself.

canonical_statement: The evolution of sentient life involves a progressive journey of the soul through various material states and forms.

attributions.surface_quote: It journeys through the Seven Worlds of Maya... becomes a Sacred Animal.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured by a hierarchical emanation from a singular source into multiple divine aspects.

attributions.surface_quote: The Three from the One, the Four from the One, and the Five.

canonical_statement: There is an essential, non-dual identity between the individual observer and the divine creators of the world.

attributions.surface_quote: It is they who are thou, I, he... the Builders... reign over Men — who are themselves.

canonical_statement: Space is the eternal, self-existent, and immovable cause of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Space is the one eternal thing... self-existent.

canonical_statement: Spirit and matter are both differentiations arising from a singular, causeless source.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit is the first differentiation from That, the Causeless Cause.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality transcends the binary of void and fullness, encompassing both simultaneously.

attributions.surface_quote: It is neither limitless void, nor conditioned fulness, but both.

canonical_statement: There exists a primordial, spiritual essence of matter that serves as the noumenal basis for all physical and mental phenomena.

attributions.surface_quote: Root-Nature is the primordial Substance, which is the basis of every phenomenon.

canonical_statement: Time is structured into vast, cyclical periods rather than being an infinite, linear progression.

attributions.surface_quote: By the Seven Eternities, aeons or periods are meant.

canonical_statement: The universe operates through cyclical periods of existence known as Manvantaras and Mahakalpas.

attributions.surface_quote: The Seven Eternities mean the seven periods of a Manvantara.

canonical_statement: The subjective, real world is governed by septenary mathematical principles.

attributions.surface_quote: Every figure must be 7^x in the subjective or real world.

canonical_statement: The objective, material world is governed by multiples of seven.

attributions.surface_quote: Every figure relating to the objective or unreal world must be multiples of seven.

canonical_statement: The symbolic meaning of numerical values shifts depending on the plane of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The figure 4 is the male symbol on the highest plane, but feminine on matter.

canonical_statement: Time is a subjective illusion generated by the sequential nature of consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Time is only an illusion produced by the succession of our states of consciousness.

canonical_statement: Time does not exist in the absence of conscious observers.

attributions.surface_quote: It does not exist where no consciousness exists in which the illusion can be.

canonical_statement: Individual entities do not cease to exist at the end of a cosmic cycle but are reabsorbed into a greater whole.

attributions.surface_quote: They perish not, but are reabsorbed.

canonical_statement: The present is a mathematical abstraction rather than an ontological reality, serving only to divide past from future.

attributions.surface_quote: The Present is only a mathematical line which divides... the Future, from... the Past.

canonical_statement: Material objects and persons lack duration because they are in a state of constant change.

attributions.surface_quote: Nothing on earth has real duration, for nothing remains without change.

canonical_statement: The perception of a continuous present is an illusion caused by the sensory blurring of successive states.

attributions.surface_quote: sensation... of the... Present, comes from the blurring of the momentary glimpse.

canonical_statement: An entity's true existence is the sum total of all its states across eternity, not its momentary material manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: The real person... is composed of the sum of all its various and changing conditions.

canonical_statement: Mind is defined as the aggregate of consciousness states, specifically thought, will, and feeling.

attributions.surface_quote: Mind is a name given to the sum of the States of Consciousness.

canonical_statement: Mind is dependent on physical organs for the manifestation of ideation and memory on the material plane.

attributions.surface_quote: the organ, through which the Ego manifests ideation and memory... has temporarily ceased.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of reality is a necessary consequence of an underlying, unmanifested principle.

attributions.surface_quote: And hence to manifest it.

canonical_statement: A noumenon requires a vehicle or basis to manifest as a phenomenon on any plane of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: A noumenon can become a phenomenon... only by manifesting... through an appropriate basis.

canonical_statement: The Universal Mind persists as a permanent potentiality of mental action during periods of cosmic dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: Universal Mind remains as a permanent possibility of mental action during Pralaya.

canonical_statement: Spiritual hierarchies act as the intelligent intermediaries for the manifestation of Divine Will in nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The Ah-hi are the Vehicle for the manifestation of the Divine or Universal Thought.

canonical_statement: Reality is structured as a nested hierarchy of individualities, where each unit is contained within a larger whole.

attributions.surface_quote: Each contained in a larger individuality... and each containing lesser individualities in itself.

canonical_statement: Absolute reality is defined as a state of non-existence that encompasses absolute being, existence, and consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Bliss of NonExistence, which is absolute Being, Existence and Consciousness.

canonical_statement: The manifest universe originates as a projection of divine thought prior to its physical realization.

attributions.surface_quote: the Universe, so far, was empty, and existed only in the Divine Thought.

canonical_statement: Existence is a causal chain where each state is both an effect of a predecessor and a cause for a successor.

attributions.surface_quote: Each is the effect of its antecedent cause, and a cause, in its turn, to its successor.

canonical_statement: Reincarnation is a continuous cycle of suffering that persists beyond physical death.

attributions.surface_quote: death is merely the door through which he passes to another life on earth

canonical_statement: Liberation from the cycle of rebirth is achieved through the acquisition of wisdom and knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: man may escape the sufferings of rebirth... by obtaining Wisdom and Knowledge

canonical_statement: Finite existence possesses only relative reality, as all phenomena are projections of a hidden noumenon.

attributions.surface_quote: everything that exists has only a relative, not an absolute, reality

canonical_statement: The perception of reality is dependent upon the cognitive capacity of the observer.

attributions.surface_quote: the appearance which the hidden noumenon assumes... depends upon his power of cognition

canonical_statement: The only absolute reality is the singular, non-dual existence that underlies all phenomena.

attributions.surface_quote: Nothing is permanent except the one hidden absolute Existence

canonical_statement: The evolution of the Ego is a progressive series of awakenings where previous perceptions of reality are revealed as illusions.

attributions.surface_quote: the upward progress of the Ego is a series of progressive awakenings

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is currently limited by the illusions of Maya.

attributions.surface_quote: free from the delusions produced by Maya

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of existence involves the dissolution of individual consciousness into absolute consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: when we shall have reached absolute Consciousness, and blended our own with it

canonical_statement: Prior to the manifestation of the universe, all aspects of reality exist in a state of undifferentiated unity.

attributions.surface_quote: Father, Mother and Son were once more one

canonical_statement: The manifestation of the universe is a cyclical process involving the awakening of consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: the Son had not yet awakened for the new Wheel

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an eternal, undifferentiated substrate from which all phenomena of light and darkness emerge.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness is the Eternal Matrix in which the Sources of Light appear and disappear.

canonical_statement: Light and darkness are not ontological opposites but interchangeable modes of a single underlying reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Light is but a mode of darkness and vice versa.

canonical_statement: The perception of reality is relative to the observer's level of consciousness and sensory capacity.

attributions.surface_quote: How far we discern the light that shines in darkness depends upon our powers of vision.

canonical_statement: The universe manifests through the interaction of dual principles, Spirit and Substance, which resolve into unity during periods of non-existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Father and Mother are the male and female principles in Root-Nature.

canonical_statement: Existence is cyclical, alternating between periods of objective manifestation and dissolution into the primal cause.

attributions.surface_quote: When the whole Universe was plunged in sleep... it had returned to its one primordial element.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes periodic cycles of dissolution into a primal cause and subsequent manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: The previous objective Universe has dissolved into its one primal and eternal Cause.

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is a triune expression of Spirit, Soul, and Body, representing the Divine Breath.

attributions.surface_quote: Brahma is Father-Mother-Son, or Spirit, Soul and Body at once.

canonical_statement: Human existence is a manifestation of the interaction between Spirit and Matter during cyclic evolutionary periods.

attributions.surface_quote: Man—the son of the two, the creature of Spirit and Matter.

canonical_statement: A hierarchy of creative intelligences governs the development of planetary chains and human root-races.

attributions.surface_quote: The Dhyanis watch successively over one of the Rounds and the great Root-Races.

canonical_statement: The evolution of consciousness and form occurs in cyclical stages corresponding to Root-Races and Rounds.

attributions.surface_quote: every new Root-Race at the head of a Round must have its revelation

canonical_statement: Paranishpanna represents a state of absolute perfection attained at the conclusion of a cosmic cycle.

attributions.surface_quote: Paranishpanna is the Absolute Perfection to which all Existences attain at the close

canonical_statement: Non-Ego, Voidness, and Darkness constitute a singular, self-existent, and perfect reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Non-Ego, Voidness, and Darkness are Three in One, and alone self-existent

canonical_statement: Absolute perfection is relative, as it must evolve into higher standards of excellence in subsequent cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: It is absolute, however, only in a relative sense

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes infinite, beginningless, and endless development.

attributions.surface_quote: stupendous development has neither conceivable beginning nor imaginable end

canonical_statement: The universe exists as a link in an infinite chain of causal universes.

attributions.surface_quote: each one standing in the relation of an effect as regards its predecessor

canonical_statement: The manifestation and dissolution of the universe are rhythmic processes of the eternal Great Breath.

attributions.surface_quote: appearance and disappearance of the Universe are pictured as an outbreathing and inbreathing

canonical_statement: The Absolute is defined by the three symbols of Motion, Abstract Space, and Duration.

attributions.surface_quote: Motion, is one of the three symbols of the Absolute — Abstract Space and Duration

canonical_statement: The cosmos is a thought projected by the Unknowable Deity.

attributions.surface_quote: Unknowable Deity — the One Existence— which breathes out a thought

canonical_statement: The division of time into past, present, and future is a phenomenal construct without validity in the noumenal realm.

attributions.surface_quote: the three are a composite number only in relation to the phenomenal plane

canonical_statement: Time is fundamentally a succession of states of consciousness rather than an objective external reality.

attributions.surface_quote: What is time, for instance, but the panoramic succession of our states of consciousness?

canonical_statement: Human perception of duration is a product of sensory association and the limitations of the individual ego.

attributions.surface_quote: Our ideas on duration and time are all derived from our sensations

canonical_statement: The experience of time as a linear progression is an illusion (Maya) that ceases upon the evolution of the individual consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: perish when its evolutionary march dispels the Maya of phenomenal existence

canonical_statement: The fundamental cause of existence is a primordial desire for sentient life, manifesting from the atomic level to the cosmic scale.

attributions.surface_quote: the desire to exist... shows itself in everything, from an atom to a sun

canonical_statement: The objective universe is a manifestation of Divine Thought governed by an inherent law of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: reflection of the Divine Thought propelled into objective existence

canonical_statement: True self-consciousness is a prerequisite for understanding the nature of delusion and the illusory aspects of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: acquire true Self-Consciousness in order to understand Samvriti, or the origin of delusion

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is characterized by a reflective process of self-analysis.

attributions.surface_quote: Paramartha is the synonym of... the reflection which analyses itself

canonical_statement: The material universe is the result of metaphysical abstractions condensing into physical form.

attributions.surface_quote: process of conversion of metaphysics into physics

canonical_statement: Human perception of existence is limited by current consciousness, obscuring the true nature of 'Being'.

attributions.surface_quote: we limit our ideas of Being to our present consciousness of Existence

canonical_statement: Phenomenal reality is supported by a noumenal substrate that provides its essential value and reality.

attributions.surface_quote: noumenon of all the noumena which we know must underlie phenomena

canonical_statement: Causality is a necessary requirement for mental conception; the mind cannot conceive of an uncaused state.

attributions.surface_quote: It is impossible to conceive anything without a cause

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a singular, boundless, and causeless existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The One Form of Existence stretched boundless, infinite, causeless.

canonical_statement: The primordial state of existence is characterized by unconsciousness, analogous to dreamless sleep.

attributions.surface_quote: Life pulsated unconscious in universal space throughout that dreamless sleep.

canonical_statement: Phenomenal reality is a veil of illusion that obscures the true essence of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Veils them, and in which they are hidden... no Maya can have any influence.

canonical_statement: All phenomena originate from and resolve into a single, homogeneous metaphysical substrate.

attributions.surface_quote: One Form of Existence as the basis and source of all things.

canonical_statement: The ultimate cause of the universe is an abstract, self-existent essence that functions as both cause and effect.

attributions.surface_quote: Svabhavat... the Eternal Cause and Effect, omnipresent yet abstract.

canonical_statement: Spiritual intuition is a faculty of direct knowledge distinct from sensory perception or spatial clairvoyance.

attributions.surface_quote: The faculty of spiritual intuition, through which direct and certain knowledge is obtainable.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a material cause that exists as an ideal spirit rather than a physical substance.

attributions.surface_quote: Esoteric Philosophy, by the ideal spirit of that cause.

canonical_statement: The universe possesses a fundamental, dual-aspected substrate known as Mulaprakriti.

attributions.surface_quote: Mulaprakriti, the one under two aspects.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is divided into seven distinct states, each corresponding to a different plane of being.

attributions.surface_quote: Dreamless Sleep is one of the seven states of consciousness.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes a state analogous to human dreamless sleep, characterized by an objective consciousness that remains inaccessible to the waking state.

attributions.surface_quote: Dreamless Sleep is applied allegorically to the Universe.

canonical_statement: The Universal Soul (Alaya) serves as the fundamental substrate of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Alaya, the Universal Soul. Soul, as the basis of all, Anima Mundi.

canonical_statement: Absolute Being and Absolute Consciousness are identical to Absolute Non-Being and Absolute Unconsciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Absolute Being and Consciousness, which are Absolute Non-Being and Unconsciousness.

canonical_statement: The Alaya is a universal substrate that remains immutable in its essence while undergoing periodic changes on lower planes of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Alaya, though eternal and changeless... changes during the active life-period with respect to the lower planes.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness can achieve a state of union with the universal substrate through meditative practice.

attributions.surface_quote: man strong in Yoga is able to merge his soul with it.

canonical_statement: The universal substrate reflects itself into all phenomenal objects, similar to a reflection in water.

attributions.surface_quote: it reflects itself in every object of the Universe like the moon in clear tranquil water.

canonical_statement: Phenomenal existence is categorized into relative truth, dependent origination, and absolute reality.

attributions.surface_quote: the former believe... there exists only relative truth; and the latter teach the existence of Absolute Truth.

canonical_statement: Dependent phenomena are transient and cease to exist upon the removal of their causal conditions.

attributions.surface_quote: Paratantra is that... which exists only through a dependent or causal connection.

canonical_statement: All entities in the universe possess life and consciousness, though these manifest in diverse forms beyond human or animal experience.

attributions.surface_quote: everything lives and is conscious, but not that all life and consciousness are similar.

canonical_statement: Spirit, Soul, and Matter are not distinct entities but a unified trinity synthesized by a pervasive Universal Life.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit, Soul and Matter are a Trinity synthesized by Life, which pervades them all.

canonical_statement: Matter serves as a vehicle for the manifestation of Soul, while Soul serves as a vehicle for the manifestation of Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: Matter is the Vehicle for the manifestation of Soul... Soul is the Vehicle... for the manifestation of Spirit.

canonical_statement: Universal Life is an inherent property of all entities, from subatomic particles to celestial bodies.

attributions.surface_quote: things that have life are living things, whether they be atoms or planets.

canonical_statement: Alaya functions as both the Universal Soul (Anima Mundi) and the realized self of an adept.

attributions.surface_quote: Alaya is both the Universal Soul, Anima Mundi, and the Self of a progressed Adept.

canonical_statement: The ultimate cause of existence is an eternal, unevolved base that simultaneously encompasses being, non-being, and process.

attributions.surface_quote: Pradhana is the unevolved cause... which is eternal, and which at once is and is not.

canonical_statement: The finite mind is inherently incapable of comprehending the nature of the infinite.

attributions.surface_quote: Can the finite conceive the infinite?

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality, Brahma, does not create the universe but manifests as various aspects of itself.

attributions.surface_quote: Brahma does not put forth evolution itself or create, but only exhibits various aspects.

canonical_statement: The Universal Soul or One Life is an eternal, primordial principle that predates human philosophical history.

attributions.surface_quote: the Anima Mundi, the One Life or Universal Soul, was made known only by Anaxagoras.

canonical_statement: The fundamental principle of the universe is infinite and exists independently of the finite attribute of thinking.

attributions.surface_quote: Arjan philosophers never endowed this principle, which with them is infinite, with the finite thinking.

canonical_statement: The Absolute evolves the universe as a mechanism to achieve self-consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: the Unconscious would never have undertaken... the task of evolving the Universe, except in the hope of attaining clear Self-Consciousness.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness serves as the highest known aspect of the Absolute's self-realization.

attributions.surface_quote: how can the Absolute attain this otherwise than simply as an aspect, the highest of which aspects known to us is human consciousness?

canonical_statement: The term 'Unconscious' as applied to the Absolute is a symbolic placeholder for an incomprehensible mystery.

attributions.surface_quote: It is employed in the absence of a better term to symbolize a profound mystery.

canonical_statement: The Absolute is beyond the reach of human conceptualization and empirical experience.

attributions.surface_quote: Man is powerless to raise the veil that shrouds the majesty of the Absolute.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is a finite state that cannot comprehend the Infinite.

attributions.surface_quote: The Finite cannot conceive the Infinite.

canonical_statement: Spirit and Matter are dual aspects of a single, non-dual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit and Matter are but the two primeval aspects of the One.

canonical_statement: A universal soul or animating principle is immanent in all matter, from stones to humans.

attributions.surface_quote: The animating Soul is immanent in every atom, manifested in man, latent in the stone.

canonical_statement: Liberated beings achieve a state of existence where individual personality merges into universal consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The merging of the individual in the universal consciousness.

canonical_statement: The Absolute is self-existent and lacks causal origin.

attributions.surface_quote: The Concealed Lord can have no parents since he is Self-Existent.

canonical_statement: Individual human souls possess the latent potential of the Anupadaka state.

attributions.surface_quote: Every soul-endowed man also is an Anupadaka in a latent state.

canonical_statement: The universe in its pre-manifest, absolute condition is formless and eternal.

attributions.surface_quote: The great Wheel was Anupadaka in its formless, eternal, or absolute condition.

canonical_statement: Reality is structured as a hierarchy connecting the Universal Spirit to individual human consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The mystery of the Hierarchy of the Anupadaka is great.

canonical_statement: The universe is architected by intelligent entities known as Builders who operate within a planetary system.

attributions.surface_quote: The Builders are the real creators of the Universe.

canonical_statement: The primordial state of existence is a condition of non-being or formlessness from which all form emerges.

attributions.surface_quote: The Producers of Form from No-Form rested in the Bliss of Non-Being.

canonical_statement: Individual human consciousness is essentially identical to universal consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The essence of man is spirit; identity of the individual with the universal Consciousness.

canonical_statement: The realization of truth requires the individual to transcend finiteness and merge with pure self-consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Only by stripping himself of his finiteness does he attain the truth.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes periodic cycles of dissolution and manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: There are many kinds of Pralaya (dissolution of a thing visible).

canonical_statement: Absolute Being is identical to Non-Being.

attributions.surface_quote: Non-Being, which, as explained, is Absolute Being.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of existence requires both the Absolute and self-analyzing consciousness to be meaningful.

attributions.surface_quote: Paranishpanna, without Paramartha, the Self-analysing Consciousness, is no bliss.

canonical_statement: Liberation involves the dissolution of personal identity into the Absolute while retaining conscious awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: one gets rid of personal existence, merging into, becoming one with, the Absolute.

canonical_statement: The primordial state of reality is a self-unaware, eternal, and undifferentiated substrate.

attributions.surface_quote: Naught save Breath, which knows itself not.

canonical_statement: Non-being is equivalent to absolute being.

attributions.surface_quote: Non-Being is Absolute Being in Esoteric Philosophy.

canonical_statement: All manifested entities, including deities, are illusory and subject to dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: all the gods... have to die at the end of the Age of Brahma.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a singular, undifferentiated, and absolute existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Parabrahman... alone being the One Absolute Reality.

canonical_statement: The absolute reality lacks self-reflexive consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: THE ABSOLUTE KNOWS ITSELF NOT.

canonical_statement: An entity can undergo a transformation into a new state while maintaining its fundamental identity.

attributions.surface_quote: a thing, which has become something else and yet has not ceased to be itself.

canonical_statement: The transition between manifest existence and non-manifest states is a cyclical process of awakening and sleeping.

attributions.surface_quote: symbolize the condition of the Universe when it goes to sleep... during the Nights of Brahma

canonical_statement: Space, duration, matter, and motion are coexistent, eternal, and fundamental constituents of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: coexistent with which are Endless Duration, Primordial Matter, and Motion

canonical_statement: Absolute motion is an eternal, ceaseless property of the One Element, persisting even during universal dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: This Breath, as seen, can never cease, not even during the Pralayic Eternities.

canonical_statement: The manifest universe is distinct from the One Causeless Cause, which serves as the ultimate ideal origin.

attributions.surface_quote: Save that One Causeless Ideal Cause there is no other to which the Universe can be referred.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an absolute, unknowable essence that transcends all human conceptualization and finite perception.

attributions.surface_quote: The Unknown and the Unknowable Mover is the Absolute Divine Essence.

canonical_statement: Absolute consciousness is fundamentally distinct from concrete consciousness, as the latter requires a subject-object duality that the former transcends.

attributions.surface_quote: Consciousness implies limitations and qualifications; something to be conscious of, and someone to be conscious of it.

canonical_statement: Absolute consciousness contains the cognizer, the object of cognition, and the act of cognition as a singular, unified totality.

attributions.surface_quote: Absolute Consciousness contains the cognizer, the thing cognized and the cognition, all three in itself.

canonical_statement: Human language and perception necessarily mischaracterize the Absolute by projecting finite limitations onto it.

attributions.surface_quote: We give names to things according to the appearances they assume for ourselves.

canonical_statement: The Absolute is characterized by absolute motion, which appears as immovability to finite observers.

attributions.surface_quote: Being Absolute Consciousness, and Absolute Motion—to the limited senses... it is unconsciousness and immovableness.

canonical_statement: Absolute Consciousness is indistinguishable from unconsciousness to the human mind due to the limitations of conceptual thought.

attributions.surface_quote: we cannot distinguish Absolute Consciousness from what appears to us as unconsciousness.

canonical_statement: The fundamental germ of life exists as a noumenal presence within every atom of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: a germ exists in the centre of every atom.

canonical_statement: The universe is generated through the interaction of a dual principle: an active, masculine fire (Spirit) and a passive, feminine ether (Matter).

attributions.surface_quote: fire is the Father, and ether or water is the Mother.

canonical_statement: All manifestations in the physical universe are preformed as embryonic structures within the noumenal seed of matter.

attributions.surface_quote: seeds contain perfectly formed leaves of what they will become.

canonical_statement: Spiritual prototypes of all physical entities exist in an immaterial realm prior to material manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: spiritual prototypes of all things exist in the immaterial world, before these things become materialized

canonical_statement: The structure and developmental trajectory of the individual human being are isomorphic to the structure and development of the Cosmos.

attributions.surface_quote: the elements of both are the same, and that both are developing in the same direction

canonical_statement: Existence is stratified into material, astral, and spiritual dimensions, represented by the root, stalk, and flower.

attributions.surface_quote: root... material life, the stalk... astral world, and the flower... spiritual being

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is a homogeneous Universal Unity that manifests through a triadic structure.

attributions.surface_quote: first and fundamental dogma of Occultism is Universal Unity (or Homogeneity) under three aspects

canonical_statement: Absolute Deity is inherently incomprehensible to the finite human intellect.

attributions.surface_quote: absolute Unity must remain forever incomprehensible to finite intellects

canonical_statement: The underlying power or essence of a thing cannot be perceived or conceived independently of its manifest forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou canst not imagine that Power independently of these objects

canonical_statement: The Absolute is omnipresent and exists within every atom of the manifested universe.

attributions.surface_quote: The Deity being absolute, must be omnipresent; hence not an atom but contains It.

canonical_statement: Manifested reality is inherently triple, requiring privation, form, and matter to achieve objectivity.

attributions.surface_quote: It requires three principles for every natural body to become objective: privation, form, and matter.

canonical_statement: The union of the triple principles of manifestation is animated by a fourth principle, the universal Life-Essence.

attributions.surface_quote: The union of these three principles depends upon a fourth — the Life which radiates.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is not a Being, but 'Be-ness' or Life itself, which is sexless and abstract.

attributions.surface_quote: The Abstract Deity being sexless, and not even a Being but Be-ness, or Life itself.

canonical_statement: The manifested universe is a dependent aspect or garment of the changeless, eternal Substance.

attributions.surface_quote: Chit and Achit are the garment, or body, or rather aspect of Parabrahman.

canonical_statement: The divine creative process is mirrored in terrestrial existence through the emanation of humanity from an androgynous cosmic principle.

attributions.surface_quote: The mystery enacted on the divine plane is repeated on earth.

canonical_statement: The macrocosmic reality is reflected and limited within the microcosmic human form through the process of manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: The Macroprosopus is now Microprosopus.

canonical_statement: The astral light acts as a veil of illusion that obscures the perception of ultimate reality from limited human senses.

attributions.surface_quote: The Astral Light is the Great Deceiver of man's limited senses.

canonical_statement: Svabhavat is the fundamental, plastic essence or substrate that serves as the root of all existence and the body of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: Svabhavat, the Plastic Essence that fills the Universe, is the root of all things.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a self-subsistent substance that possesses no inherent nature of its own.

attributions.surface_quote: the nature which has no nature of its own.

canonical_statement: The universe is an expression of an impersonal Divine Thought, rather than the product of a conscious Divine Thinker.

attributions.surface_quote: The Divine Thought does not imply the idea of a Divine Thinker.

canonical_statement: Absolute Being exists in an eternal present where past and future are crystallized.

attributions.surface_quote: Absolute Being, with the Past and Future crystallized in an eternal Present.

canonical_statement: Boundless duration is divided into an unconditioned, eternal noumenon and a conditioned, periodic phenomenon.

attributions.surface_quote: divides boundless Duration into unconditionally eternal and universal Time and conditioned Time.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an eternal, attribute-less, and self-existing noumenon, while the objective universe is a periodical, illusory reflection.

attributions.surface_quote: Mulaprakriti, the noumenon, is self-existing... Prakriti, its phenomenon, is periodical and no better than a phantasm.

canonical_statement: Universal manifestation occurs through an eternal, changeless law of cyclic activity and rest, rather than divine intervention.

attributions.surface_quote: The last Vibration... occurred in virtue of the eternal and changeless Law.

canonical_statement: The transition from subjectivity to objectivity is a change of condition rather than a spatial expansion.

attributions.surface_quote: This expansion... was a change of condition, not an increase in size.

canonical_statement: All objective entities are temporary reflections of eternal ideal prototypes existing within Divine Thought.

attributions.surface_quote: All this is but the temporary reflection, the shadow of the eternal ideal prototype.

canonical_statement: The universe is a transient manifestation, comparable to a fleeting shadow.

attributions.surface_quote: The universe, a flitting shadow.

canonical_statement: Individual cosmic cycles are governed by personified archetypes of Divine Thought.

attributions.surface_quote: Every Manu is but the personified idea of the Thought Divine.

canonical_statement: Phenomenal reality is the result of ideal prototypes expanding from noumenal states into objective matter.

attributions.surface_quote: Ideal prototypes expand from within without to bloom into full objectivity.

canonical_statement: Objective matter represents the highest degree of illusion.

attributions.surface_quote: Full objectivity, the acme of Illusion, or the grossest matter.

canonical_statement: Primordial space is not empty but contains latent Spirit and Matter.

attributions.surface_quote: The vacuum is not empty space, for it contains latent Spirit and Matter.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of existence is an eternal, unconscious breath or principle.

attributions.surface_quote: The Eternal Breath of the unconscious All.

canonical_statement: Divine intelligence acts upon primordial chaos to initiate the manifestation of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Divine Thought, or Intelligence, impregnating Chaos.

canonical_statement: The primordial form of all manifested existence, from atoms to celestial bodies, is spheroidal.

attributions.surface_quote: primordial form of everything manifested, from atom to globe, is spheroidal.

canonical_statement: The infinite nature of the universe is represented by a sphere whose center is everywhere and circumference is nowhere.

attributions.surface_quote: whose centre is everywhere and circumference nowhere.

canonical_statement: Metaphysical abstractions are considered objective realities on higher planes of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: the plane whereon that which we call a metaphysical abstraction, is a reality.

canonical_statement: The universe originates from a primeval, undifferentiated state often symbolized as a virgin egg or chaos.

attributions.surface_quote: The Virgin-Egg is the microcosmic symbol of the macrocosmic prototype, the Virgin Mother — Chaos.

canonical_statement: Cosmic evolution is a process of self-generation driven by an unseen creative spirit acting upon receptive nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The mystery of apparent self-generation and evolution through its own creative power.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe consists of seven elements, divided into four manifest and three hidden components.

attributions.surface_quote: The Golden Egg was surrounded by seven natural Elements, four ready, three secret.

canonical_statement: The macrocosm and microcosm are structurally isomorphic, with the latter reflecting the evolutionary processes of the former.

attributions.surface_quote: Repeating in miniature, in the egg, the process of cosmic evolution.

canonical_statement: The creative process involves the interaction of a male principle (the Ray) with a receptive female principle (the Virgin Mother).

attributions.surface_quote: The male creator springs forth from the virgin female, the Immaculate Root fructified by the Ray.

canonical_statement: Matter and Spirit are the extreme poles of a single, unified substance.

attributions.surface_quote: the two standing in relation to each other as Matter stands to Spirit

canonical_statement: Numbers are metaphysical entities that function as the organizing principles of the physical cosmos.

attributions.surface_quote: Number is... an Entity... the Breath which alone could organize the physical Cosmos

canonical_statement: The physical form of all things is a direct manifestation of numerical influence.

attributions.surface_quote: naught obtains its form but through the Deity, which is an effect of Number

canonical_statement: The structure of all existence, from the infinitesimal to the immense, is derived from and governed by numerical principles.

attributions.surface_quote: all begotten by Number

canonical_statement: The Divine is an abstract, non-demonstrable principle of motion that exists independently of the numerical system it generates.

attributions.surface_quote: God is a Number endowed with motion

canonical_statement: Unity is the singular, non-participatory source from which all numerical multiplicity originates.

attributions.surface_quote: The existence of Numbers depends on Unity

canonical_statement: The Word (Logos) acts as the causal origin for both Motion and Number, serving as the supreme organizing reason of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Motion and Number are begotten by the Word

canonical_statement: Primordial matter is a radiant, universal substance that permeates space as the foundational material of all manifested worlds.

attributions.surface_quote: The Radiant Essence curdles and spreads throughout the Depths of Space

canonical_statement: The cow and bull are metaphysical symbols representing the productive and generative powers inherent in Nature.

attributions.surface_quote: cow and bull, one the productive, the other the generative power in Nature

canonical_statement: The 'Churning of the Ocean' refers to a cosmic event occurring prior to the physical formation of the Earth.

attributions.surface_quote: This 'Churning' relates to a period before the earth's formation

canonical_statement: The fundamental reality of the universe is a singular, septenary root from which all existence proceeds.

attributions.surface_quote: the Septenary Root from which all proceeds

canonical_statement: Sacred texts often employ intentional obfuscation to preserve esoteric knowledge from the uninitiated.

attributions.surface_quote: occult works, hence used purposely as blinds

canonical_statement: All existence is fundamentally non-separate and unified, regardless of its active or passive state.

attributions.surface_quote: Non-Separateness of all that lives and has its being

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an unconditioned, eternal unity that manifests as both consciousness and matter.

attributions.surface_quote: Parabrahman or Mulaprakriti, for these are but the two symbols of the One.

canonical_statement: Cosmic matter undergoes periodic cycles of differentiation triggered by the infusion of spiritual light.

attributions.surface_quote: Omnipresent Spiritual Ray... calls cosmic matter to begin its long series of differentiations.

canonical_statement: The universe exists in alternating cycles of manifestation and dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: during the periodical Sleep of the Universe

canonical_statement: The fundamental essence of the universe is a synthesis of spiritual light, heat, and motion.

attributions.surface_quote: Ocean was Radiant Light, which was Fire, and Heat, and Motion.

canonical_statement: The state of non-being or universal rest is perceived by finite consciousness as darkness, though it is fundamentally absolute light.

attributions.surface_quote: The Essence of Darkness being Absolute Light.

canonical_statement: Physical phenomena like fire, heat, and motion are manifestations of underlying noumenal abstractions.

attributions.surface_quote: not the fire, heat, and motion of Physical Science, but the underlying abstractions.

canonical_statement: The dual Monad, Atma-Buddhi, serves as the structural equivalent to the higher-plane principles of Parabrahman and Mulaprakriti.

attributions.surface_quote: Sattva is the name given... to the dual Monad, or Atma-Buddhi.

canonical_statement: The underlying essence of material objects is inaccessible to empirical observation and rational cognition.

attributions.surface_quote: things in themselves... entirely elude the instruments of the laboratory

canonical_statement: Light and darkness are ontologically identical, appearing as distinct only through the limitations of human perception.

attributions.surface_quote: Light and Darkness are identical in themselves, being only divisible in the human mind

canonical_statement: Darkness is the absolute, subjective root of existence, while light is a transient, illusory manifestation of matter.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness is the one true actuality... Light is Matter, and Darkness pure Spirit.

canonical_statement: The Absolute (Darkness) is incapable of cognizing transient, phenomenal light.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness, the Absolute, that comprehendeth not transient Light

canonical_statement: The divine or spiritual principle is often inverted or misidentified as evil by dogmatic religious structures.

attributions.surface_quote: Demon est Deus inversus. The Devil is now called darkness by the Church

canonical_statement: The manifested universe originates from a primordial, undifferentiated state of 'Dark Space' which gives rise to a differentiated 'Bright Space' or Logos.

attributions.surface_quote: Bright Space, Son of Dark Space, corresponds to the Ray dropped into Cosmic Depths.

canonical_statement: The phenomenal world perceived by sentient beings is a 'Great Illusion' created by the veiling of higher, non-manifested realities.

attributions.surface_quote: He shuts out the Above, and leaves the Below to be seen as the Great Illusion.

canonical_statement: The first manifestation of the Divine contains the aggregate of Universal Wisdom and serves as the germ for all subsequent creative hosts.

attributions.surface_quote: Oeaohoo contains in himself the Seven Creative Hosts.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is governed by numerical hierarchies where the One manifests through the differentiation of Three, Four, and Seven.

attributions.surface_quote: Eka is One; Chatur, Four; Tri, Three; and Sapta, Seven.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality or divine essence is fundamentally androgynous or bisexual in nature.

attributions.surface_quote: all the Logoi of antiquity... were represented as male-female.

canonical_statement: Manifested divine entities originate from a feminine principle before transitioning to a masculine one.

attributions.surface_quote: The higher gods of antiquity are all 'Sons of the Mother' before they become 'Sons of the Father.'

canonical_statement: The esoteric or absolute Christos exists beyond the duality of gender.

attributions.surface_quote: The esoteric Christos in the Gnosis is, of course, sexless.

canonical_statement: Perception of the phenomenal world is a deceptive veil that obscures the underlying light of wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: He who bathes in the Light of Oeaohoo will never be deceived by the Veil of Maya.

canonical_statement: The primordial creative principle of the universe is feminine in nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The earliest manifested Logos was female everywhere.

canonical_statement: The concept of a masculine 'Father' as the primary creator is a secondary historical development.

attributions.surface_quote: The 'Father' is a far later invention.

canonical_statement: Good and Evil are not independent fundamental powers but are manifestations of the Absolute.

attributions.surface_quote: recognizing neither Good nor Evil as a fundamental or independent power

canonical_statement: Matter is the result of the gradual condensation of pure spirit into form.

attributions.surface_quote: pure Light condensing gradually into form, and hence becoming Matter

canonical_statement: The serpent is a universal symbol for divine wisdom, regeneration, and immortality.

attributions.surface_quote: symbolized divine Wisdom and Perfection, and has always stood for psychical Regeneration and Immortality

canonical_statement: Infinite time in space acts as the substrate that periodically generates the manifested universe.

attributions.surface_quote: symbolizing infinite Time in Space, which contains the Germ and throws off periodically the Manifested Universe

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe proceeds from the Unmanifested Logos through a triadic and quaternary development.

attributions.surface_quote: First Unmanifested Logos, the Second Manifested, the Triangle concreting into the Quaternary

canonical_statement: The Astral Light is a dual-natured substance consisting of Spirit-Matter that manifests as divine wisdom in spiritual realms and as material illusion in physical realms.

attributions.surface_quote: the Astral Light... is Spirit-Matter. Beginning with the pure spiritual plane, it becomes grosser

canonical_statement: The universe, the earth, and human beings undergo periodic cycles of renewal, shedding previous forms to assume new ones.

attributions.surface_quote: The Universe, as also the Earth and Man, serpent-like, periodically cast off their old skins

canonical_statement: The primordial state of the universe is a fiery, serpent-like motion within space that incubates cosmic matter into globular forms.

attributions.surface_quote: a long trail of cosmic dust moved and writhed like a serpent in Space

canonical_statement: The serpent symbol represents both the infinite nature of eternity and the spherical structure of celestial bodies.

attributions.surface_quote: symbolizes not only eternity and infinitude, but also the globular shape of all bodies

canonical_statement: The individual human consciousness is fundamentally identical to the universal divine Mind or Logos.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the Nous... I am the germ of thought, the resplendent Word.

canonical_statement: The seventh principle in man is ontologically inseparable from the seventh cosmic principle.

attributions.surface_quote: this principle being inseparable in its Esse and Nature from the seventh cosmic principle.

canonical_statement: Life emerges from the union of the divine Breath and the celestial Mother principle.

attributions.surface_quote: the celestial Ocean... is the Breath of the Father... their union is Life.

canonical_statement: The ultimate origin of all existence is an eternal, ceaseless, and undifferentiated principle rather than a personal deity.

attributions.surface_quote: the 'Eternal and Ceaseless Breath of the Ael' is at the head of evolution.

canonical_statement: Universal Mind (Mahat) undergoes a process of differentiation, transitioning from divine cognition into individual self-consciousness (Egoism).

attributions.surface_quote: Mahat which was first produced is afterwards called Ego-ism, when it is born as 'I'.

canonical_statement: All objective existence is composed of a single, infinite, and unborn universal element, with all phenomena being merely differentiated aspects of this unity.

attributions.surface_quote: there is but One Universal Element, which is infinite, unborn, and undying.

canonical_statement: The noumenal light, or super-astral substance, serves as the primary radiation from the root of undifferentiated cosmic substance.

attributions.surface_quote: The 'Sea of Fire' is the Super-Astral Light, the first radiation from the Root Mulaprakriti.
