canonical_statement: The Monad is not a discrete, pre-existing entity that evolves through successive incarnations, but a manifestation of Universal Energy.

attributions.surface_quote: It would be very misleading to imagine a Monad as a separate Entity.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness emerges through a gradual process of segregation from the Universal Monas as the life-impulse progresses.

attributions.surface_quote: The tendency towards segregation into individual Monads is gradual.

canonical_statement: The Monad is defined by the Spiritual Essence vivifying a vehicle, rather than the atomic aggregation of the vehicle itself.

attributions.surface_quote: It is the Spiritual Essence which vivifies them... not the atomic aggregation.

canonical_statement: The terms 'Mineral Monad' or 'Vegetable Monad' refer to the tidal wave of spiritual evolution passing through specific arcs of the cosmic circuit.

attributions.surface_quote: The term merely means that the tidal wave of spiritual evolution is passing through that arc.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of fundamental, indestructible units of consciousness known as monads.

attributions.surface_quote: Leibnitz conceived of the Monads as elementary and indestructible units

canonical_statement: Monads possess the capacity for interaction and mutual influence, which generates all physical and spiritual phenomena.

attributions.surface_quote: endowed with the power of giving and receiving... determining all spiritual and physical phenomena

canonical_statement: Consciousness evolves through a hierarchical progression across all kingdoms of nature.

attributions.surface_quote: the Monadic consciousness through all the kingdoms

canonical_statement: Matter and Spirit are fundamentally identical and inseparable.

attributions.surface_quote: Matter is Spirit, and vice versa.

canonical_statement: The universe and the deity informing it are ontologically inseparable.

attributions.surface_quote: The Universe and the Deity which informs it are unthinkable apart from each other.

canonical_statement: Visible celestial bodies are merely gross physical shells for invisible, higher principles.

attributions.surface_quote: Our satellite is only the gross body of its invisible principles.

canonical_statement: Visible physical forms are illusory reflections of underlying, invisible realities.

attributions.surface_quote: The real Sun and the real Moon are as invisible as the real man.

canonical_statement: Monads undergo sequential life-cycles across different planetary chains.

attributions.surface_quote: Monads, who, having ended their life-Cycle on the Lunar Chain... have incarnated on the latter.

canonical_statement: The Moon exerts a primary, formative influence on Earth's biological and cyclic phenomena.

attributions.surface_quote: It is the Earth which is the satellite of the Moon.

canonical_statement: The Moon is the progenitor and formative influence of the Earth and its human inhabitants.

attributions.surface_quote: the Moon that plays the largest and most important part in the formation of Earth

canonical_statement: Human beings are the result of Lunar Monads (Pitris) evolving through a cycle of globes.

attributions.surface_quote: The Eunar Monads, or Pitris, the ancestors of man, become in reality man himself.

canonical_statement: Physical human form is constructed by Nature around an astral double projected by the Monads.

attributions.surface_quote: this subtle, finer form, which serves as the model round which Nature builds physical man.

canonical_statement: Evolution proceeds through three interwoven schemes: Monadic, Intellectual, and Physical.

attributions.surface_quote: there exists in Nature a triple evolutionary scheme for the formation of the three periodical Upadhis

canonical_statement: The three evolutionary schemes are finite reflections of Atma, the singular reality, within cosmic illusion.

attributions.surface_quote: These three are the finite aspects, or the reflections on the field of Cosmic Illusion, of Atma

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is a composite of three distinct evolutionary streams: the Monadic, the Intellectual, and the Physical.

attributions.surface_quote: It is the union of these three streams in him, which makes him the complex being.

canonical_statement: Physical nature is incapable of generating intelligence independently and requires the intervention of higher intellectual entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Nature, the physical evolutionary Power, could never evolve Intelligence unaided.

canonical_statement: The purpose of human physical existence is the transformation of the finite and transient into the infinite and eternal.

attributions.surface_quote: The transformations... of the Finite into the Infinite, of the Transient into the Eternal.

canonical_statement: The evolution of consciousness occurs in cycles where Monads enter human stages at different temporal intervals based on their development.

attributions.surface_quote: Monads which enter upon the evolutionary cycle... are in very different stages of development.

canonical_statement: The human constitution is a microcosm reflecting the structure of the macrocosmic universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Each is represented in the constitution of Man, the Microcosm of the great Macrocosm.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into a series of successive evolutionary stages or planetary spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: THE FOURTH GLOBE

canonical_statement: Human evolution proceeds through a series of seven rounds and chains, culminating in the transition to a new state after Pralaya.

attributions.surface_quote: Humanity only at the close of the Seventh Round, to be ushered into a new Chain.

canonical_statement: The fourth globe in a series serves as a unique fulcrum for evolutionary adjustment and karmic balancing.

attributions.surface_quote: The fourth member of a series occupies a unique position... the sphere of final evolutionary adjustments.

canonical_statement: The entry of new monads into the human kingdom ceases after the midpoint of the fourth round.

attributions.surface_quote: After this central turning-point... no more Monads can enter the human kingdom.

canonical_statement: Reincarnation is a necessary mechanism to account for the origin of suffering and the continuity of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Had there been no reincarnation... nor could the origin and cause of suffering ever be accounted for.

canonical_statement: All physical forms and atoms evolve by striving to emulate a pre-existing archetypal model.

attributions.surface_quote: Every Form on earth... strives in its efforts towards self-formation to follow the model.

canonical_statement: Human development is the process of the Monad achieving its absolute, awakened totality through physical incarnation.

attributions.surface_quote: Man, as the highest physical and ultimate form... the Monad, in its absolute totality.

canonical_statement: Physical human forms are vehicles for Monads that have completed prior cycles of transmigration.

attributions.surface_quote: Rupa has become the vehicle of Monads that had completed their cycle of transmigration.

canonical_statement: The physical form of humanity evolves through a process of consolidation and adaptation to changing planetary conditions across successive root-races.

attributions.surface_quote: External shapes... have changed and consolidated with every sub-race.

canonical_statement: Human biological development recapitulates the evolutionary history of the Monad's previous incarnations through lower kingdoms.

attributions.surface_quote: The physical embryo is a plant, a reptile, an animal, before it finally becomes man.

canonical_statement: The Monad is distinct from the physical human form, having been imprisoned in various transitional forms across previous cosmic cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: The Monad had passed through... every transitional form... during the three preceding Rounds.

canonical_statement: The origin of human consciousness and biological form is a subject of ontological uncertainty.

attributions.surface_quote: MAN OR APE; WHICH WAS FIRST?

canonical_statement: The Monad is the fundamental unit of consciousness that undergoes progressive incarnation across planetary cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: Monads will be liberated and pass into the astral human forms

canonical_statement: The physical body is a distinct, temporary vessel separate from the spiritual or inner man.

attributions.surface_quote: the spiritual or inner man is one thing, and his terrestrial physical casket another

canonical_statement: Physical nature operates through the continuous modeling and remodeling of material forms to achieve higher states of perfection.

attributions.surface_quote: physical nature... models and remodels as she proceeds

canonical_statement: Humanity serves as the unique physical tabernacle capable of hosting the Divine Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: man... a fit tabernacle for the overshadowing of the Divine Spirit

canonical_statement: Certain biological species are not products of natural progression but are artificial byproducts of human activity.

attributions.surface_quote: anthropoids form an exception because they were... the direct product and creation of senseless man

canonical_statement: Human evolution is characterized by a process of involutionary degradation rather than progressive ascent from lower animal forms.

attributions.surface_quote: the ape which is evolved from man

canonical_statement: The primordial state of humanity represented a higher moral and physical prototype of the current human form.

attributions.surface_quote: mankind were, morally and physically, the types and prototypes of our present race

canonical_statement: The physical and moral state of a species is subject to an inevitable law of cyclical debasement.

attributions.surface_quote: gradual debasement and degradation of man... under the action of the inevitable law of necessity

canonical_statement: The human Monad does not undergo devolution into animal forms once the human stage of evolution is attained.

attributions.surface_quote: the human Monad... never incarnates again in the form of an animal.

canonical_statement: The cosmic cycle involves a descent into maximum materiality followed by a process of spiritualization.

attributions.surface_quote: matter, having reached its lowest depths, begins to strive onward and to become spiritualized

canonical_statement: Evolutionary progress is structured into distinct cycles or 'Rounds' characterized by specific developmental tasks.

attributions.surface_quote: Then it was the work of formation; now it is that of reformation and evolutionary perfection.

canonical_statement: Humanity constitutes an ontological category fundamentally distinct from the animal kingdom.

attributions.surface_quote: Man belongs to a kingdom distinctly separate from that of the animals.

canonical_statement: Biological evolution as defined by Darwinism is incompatible with the occult doctrine of human origins.

attributions.surface_quote: neither Occultism nor Theosophy has ever supported the wild theories of the present Darwinists

canonical_statement: Evolutionary cycles repeat across successive rounds at progressively higher levels of complexity.

attributions.surface_quote: Every Round repeats the evolutionary work of the preceding Round, on a higher scale.

canonical_statement: The influx of Monadic energy into the evolutionary process ceases until the commencement of a new Manvantara.

attributions.surface_quote: the Monadic inflow, or inner evolution, is at an end till the next Manvantara.

canonical_statement: Human development precedes animal creation within the temporal structure of the Fourth Round.

attributions.surface_quote: during the Fourth Round, man appears on Earth earlier than any animal creation

canonical_statement: Physical science is epistemologically restricted to the observation of secondary evolutionary details and cannot perceive the primary occult origins of humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: Physical Science can really know nothing, for such matters lie entirely outside of its sphere

canonical_statement: Humanity does not possess an ancestral lineage derived from ape species.

attributions.surface_quote: what the Occultists have never admitted... is that man was an ape

canonical_statement: The evolution of consciousness involves a sequential progression through mineral, vegetable, animal, and human states.

attributions.surface_quote: Immetallization, Inherbation, Inzoonization and finally Incarnation

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual entities (Dhyan Chohans) are exempt from the standard evolutionary cycle through lower kingdoms.

attributions.surface_quote: These 'failures' are too far progressed... to be thrown back... into the lower kingdoms.

canonical_statement: Humanity is formed through the commingling of fallen spiritual entities with progressed animal-kingdom entities.

attributions.surface_quote: They become an active force and commingle with the elementals... to develop... humanity.

canonical_statement: The principle of analogy and correspondence is the primary method for understanding evolutionary mysteries.

attributions.surface_quote: advises the student to hold to the doctrine of analogy and correspondences.

canonical_statement: Human evolution proceeds through a cycle of increasing physical density and decreasing spiritual awareness during the downward arc of manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: primordial spirituality is eclipsed and overshadowed by nascent mentality

canonical_statement: The development of intellect and rational mind is a slower and more difficult evolutionary process than the development of the physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: mind is a slower and more difficult evolution than is the physical frame

canonical_statement: Humanity's progression is governed by cyclic periods of manifestation known as Rounds and Root-Races.

attributions.surface_quote: In each of the subsequent races and subraces, he grows more and more into an encased being

canonical_statement: The current state of human existence is defined by the dominance of intellectual activity at the expense of spiritual perception.

attributions.surface_quote: the world teeming with the results of intellectual activity and spiritual decrease

canonical_statement: Human physical and subtle bodies are composed of seven distinct hierarchies of spiritual entities.

attributions.surface_quote: The Natures of the seven Hierarchies... which compose our nature and bodies

canonical_statement: The definitions of objectivity, subjectivity, materiality, and spirituality are relative to the specific plane of existence being observed.

attributions.surface_quote: difference in such terms as objectivity and subjectivity when applied to different planes

canonical_statement: Human evolution is not a biological descent from animal ancestors, but a process of spiritual manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: Occult doctrine has never taught the modern theory of the descent of man from the ape

canonical_statement: Early human entities possessed high spiritual purity but lacked individual intellect or moral responsibility.

attributions.surface_quote: men of the Third Race were Gods by their spirituality but destitute of mind

canonical_statement: Humanity did not evolve from apes; rather, certain ancestral human forms preceded the existence of the ape species.

attributions.surface_quote: earlier teachings... did not teach the evolution of 'man' from the 'ape.'

canonical_statement: Physical appearance does not determine the presence of consciousness or the status of a being as human.

attributions.surface_quote: The man who preceded the Fourth... however much he may have looked physically like a 'gigantic ape'... was still a thinking and already a speaking man.

canonical_statement: The history of human civilization is cyclical, with earlier races possessing higher levels of development than contemporary society.

attributions.surface_quote: The Lemuro-Atlantean was a highly civilized Race... he was higher than we are with all our sciences.

canonical_statement: The progression of life and being occurs through a series of seven cyclical revolutions.

attributions.surface_quote: the dawn and round, or revolution of Life and Being round the seven smaller Wheels

canonical_statement: Humanity and the Earth evolve through a series of successive cycles, rounds, and root-races.

attributions.surface_quote: The First, Second, and the Third Root-Races.

canonical_statement: The current state of existence represents a midpoint where Spirit and Matter achieve perfect equilibrium.

attributions.surface_quote: perfect equilibrium between Spirit and Matter had to take place.

canonical_statement: The divergence of human morality into opposing paths of knowledge originated from a crisis in physiological and spiritual adjustment.

attributions.surface_quote: humanity branched off into two diametrically opposite paths.

canonical_statement: Divine beings are subject to Karmic law and consequences for their actions.

attributions.surface_quote: They fell under the eye of the Karmic Lipikas.

canonical_statement: Procreation was originally an act of Will rather than a physiological process.

attributions.surface_quote: propagation... took place through the Will of the Creators.

canonical_statement: The origin of moral transgression is traceable to a singular, primary causal event.

attributions.surface_quote: The first cause of sin.

canonical_statement: Spirit must undergo a cycle of incarnation through all states of being to achieve self-consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: to become self-conscious, Spirit must pass through every cycle of being

canonical_statement: Spirit in its primordial state is an unconscious abstraction lacking self-awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit per se is an unconscious negative abstraction.

canonical_statement: The state of absolute non-being is equivalent to absolute being, existing outside the universal cycle.

attributions.surface_quote: Atman passes into Non-Being, which is Absolute Being.

canonical_statement: Suffering is the inevitable result of karmic causes that violate natural laws, rather than a divine punishment.

attributions.surface_quote: the effects of this Karmic cause could lead the Beings... only to bad incarnations

canonical_statement: The exercise of independent will and free agency is the mechanism by which beings transcend blind adherence to natural law.

attributions.surface_quote: the 'rebellious' Angel claimed and enforced his right of independent judgment and will

canonical_statement: Spiritual entities are subject to the universal law of Karma.

attributions.surface_quote: Man and Angel are alike under Karmic Law.

canonical_statement: The transition from a divine functionary to an individual entity occurs through the exercise of autonomous will.

attributions.surface_quote: Spirit... became volitional... substituting its own will for the divine desire.

canonical_statement: A fundamental ontological distinction exists between the domain of spirit-volition and the domain of divine action.

attributions.surface_quote: The kingdom of spirits... are outside, and contrasted with... the kingdom of souls.

canonical_statement: The evolutionary trajectory of consciousness involves a descent from a higher state into material or animal existence.

attributions.surface_quote: From this state he fell — into the brute and savage.

canonical_statement: The act of creation is a process involving successive attempts by spiritual entities of varying purity.

attributions.surface_quote: This is a repetition of the failure of the 'Fathers,' the Lords of Light.

canonical_statement: Spiritual entities may lack knowledge of lower realms, hindering their creative capacity.

attributions.surface_quote: Bahak Zivo... is 'ignorant of Orcus,' he fails to do so.

canonical_statement: The spirit associated with the Earth is categorized as a female and potentially malevolent power.

attributions.surface_quote: Nazarenes regarded 'Spirit' as a female and evil Power, in its connection with our Earth.

canonical_statement: The astral light or lower soul is a dualistic substance tainted by matter and distinct from the divine spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: the Astral Spirit, which by its double essence is already tainted with matter

canonical_statement: The material world is a product of the interaction between divine light and chaotic, blind matter.

attributions.surface_quote: Dipping his hand in the chaos, which he condenses, he creates our planet.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is maintained by a dynamic equilibrium between opposing forces of light and darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: reestablish the balance between good and evil, light and darkness.

canonical_statement: Planetary entities and human vices are manifestations of an astral soul separated from its divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: the Seven Stellars (Planets), which represent also the seven capital sins

canonical_statement: The human form is initially a material shell lacking the divine soul.

attributions.surface_quote: created man as a shell only

canonical_statement: The animation of the divine soul requires the acquisition of secret, ineffable knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: fails to get hold of the Living Fire... ignorant of the secret name

canonical_statement: Matter and concupiscence constitute a form of existence devoid of higher mind.

attributions.surface_quote: spirit of Matter and Concupiscence; Kama Rupa minus Manas

canonical_statement: Archetypal figures of creation and divine identity recur across disparate cultural and religious traditions.

attributions.surface_quote: Mano of the Nazarenes strangely resembles the Hindu Manu

canonical_statement: The Astral Light, or Anima Mundi, is a dualistic, bi-sexual substrate that serves as the life-principle for all living entities.

attributions.surface_quote: The Astral Light or Anima Mundi is dual and bi-sexual.

canonical_statement: The male aspect of the Astral Light is divine and spiritual, while the female aspect is identified with matter and perceived as evil.

attributions.surface_quote: The male part is divine... the female portion is tainted with matter.

canonical_statement: The soul undergoes a progressive evolutionary sequence from mineral to plant, animal, human, spirit, and finally godhood.

attributions.surface_quote: A stone becomes a plant; a plant, a beast; a beast, a man; a man, a spirit; and the spirit, a god.

canonical_statement: Non-human living beings possess only a latent germ of the immortal soul, requiring extensive evolution to fully develop.

attributions.surface_quote: Animals have only the latent germ of the highest immortal soul in them.

canonical_statement: The hierarchy of angelic beings progresses from passive, incorporeal states to active, corporeal states.

attributions.surface_quote: progression in the angelic natures, viz., from the passive down to the active

canonical_statement: The Ahamkara element represents the plane where individual ego-consciousness or 'I-am-ness' originates.

attributions.surface_quote: Ahamkara Element — the region or plane wherein Egoship, or the feeling of I-am-ness, is beginning to be defined

canonical_statement: The Astral Light functions as a lower, polarized reflection of the higher Akasha or Anima Mundi.

attributions.surface_quote: The Astral Light stands in the same relation to Akasha and Anima Mundi, as Satan stands to the Deity.

canonical_statement: Reality is structured as a septenary chain of worlds descending from pure spirit into dense matter.

attributions.surface_quote: seven regions disposed like a stair, for its steps mount and descend the scale.

canonical_statement: Entities become increasingly material and less spiritual as they emanate further from their origin.

attributions.surface_quote: reflections one of the other, who become darker and more material, as they recede.

canonical_statement: The physical plane represents the lowest, most material point in the cosmic hierarchy.

attributions.surface_quote: Earth is the lowest.

canonical_statement: The psychic realm functions as an intermediary link between pure spirit and physical matter.

attributions.surface_quote: the psychic — the super-ethereal, or connecting link between matter and pure spirit.

canonical_statement: The entity traditionally identified as Satan functions as an initiator who bestows spiritual consciousness and liberation from ignorance and mortality upon humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: Satan... gives him... the law of the Spirit of Life, and makes him free from the Sin of Ignorance.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes cyclical processes of dissolution (pralaya) and reconstruction, where matter is recycled into new forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Worlds... evolve after a periodical Pralaya, rebuilt from old material into new forms.

canonical_statement: The evolution of worlds is governed by an overarching, impersonal Law that directs the actions of subordinate creative entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Law, the Law which rules all the smaller Creators.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is organized into a hierarchy of seven distinct planes of consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The three upper are the three higher planes of consciousness.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into a hierarchical series of planes of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: the lower represent the four lower planes

canonical_statement: The visible universe occupies the lowest position in the hierarchy of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: the lowest being our plane, or the visible Universe

canonical_statement: There exists a formative or substantial world that underlies or precedes the visible universe.

attributions.surface_quote: The Substantial or Formative World

canonical_statement: The structure of the cosmos consists of seven distinct planes of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: These seven planes correspond to the seven states of consciousness in man.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness possesses seven states that correspond to the seven cosmic planes.

attributions.surface_quote: These seven planes correspond to the seven states of consciousness in man.

canonical_statement: The three higher cosmic planes are currently inaccessible to the human intellect.

attributions.surface_quote: the three higher planes being inaccessible to human intellect as developed at present.

canonical_statement: The archetypal world serves as a foundational model for subsequent physical worlds, which experience a decline in purity.

attributions.surface_quote: a World made as a first model... deteriorating in purity.

canonical_statement: The Arupa plane is a state of existence where objective form ceases to exist.

attributions.surface_quote: The Arupa, or 'Formless'; there where form ceases to exist.

canonical_statement: Physical matter is a coarse, differentiated state of a more fundamental, supersensuous spiritual substance.

attributions.surface_quote: terrestrial matter from the finer grades of supersensuous matter

canonical_statement: Every primordial seed of matter contains the potential to evolve into a celestial being or deity.

attributions.surface_quote: every Seed is an ethereal organism, from which evolves later on a celestial Being

canonical_statement: Absolute light is indistinguishable from absolute darkness, requiring the presence of primordial matter as a 'shadow' to manifest existence.

attributions.surface_quote: light without any shadow would be absolute light; in other words, absolute darkness

canonical_statement: The universe is set into motion by a fundamental, intelligent force that organizes primordial dust into structured celestial bodies.

attributions.surface_quote: The Central Sun causes Fohat to collect primordial dust

canonical_statement: The metaphysical structure of reality includes a state of conflict or ontological tension within the non-physical or celestial realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The war in heaven.

canonical_statement: The evolutionary principle of struggle for existence and survival of the fittest governs all levels of reality, from cosmic bodies to human societies.

attributions.surface_quote: The struggle for existence and the survival of the fittest reigned supreme from the moment that Kosmos manifested.

canonical_statement: Cosmic phenomena, such as the formation and interaction of celestial bodies, are governed by the same laws of conflict and attraction as biological life.

attributions.surface_quote: The older bodies attract the younger, while others repel them. Many perish, devoured by their stronger companions.

canonical_statement: Mythological narratives of divine wars are allegorical representations of astronomical events and the fundamental laws of cosmic evolution.

attributions.surface_quote: All these relate to Heaven and Earth, and have a double, and often even a triple, meaning and esoteric application.

canonical_statement: There is a structural correspondence between the macrocosm of celestial bodies and the microcosm of human history and individual existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Esoteric application to things above as to things below.

canonical_statement: The development and transformation of biological species occur through a process of gradual evolution and natural selection.

attributions.surface_quote: anticipating him and his school in the natural selection, gradual development and transformation of species.

canonical_statement: The physical universe is populated by entities that originated from a state of celestial existence and were subsequently displaced into material space.

attributions.surface_quote: a third of the stars of the rebellious Host was hurled down into Space

canonical_statement: The formation of celestial bodies follows a process of transmigration where the principles of a deceased sidereal body inform primordial substance.

attributions.surface_quote: principles of a just deceased sidereal body inform primordial substance

canonical_statement: The universe is governed by a principle of evolutionary struggle and survival of the fittest across all scales of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: A struggle for life and a survival of the fittest are distinctly taught

canonical_statement: All celestial bodies originate from seven primordial entities emanated from a singular trinitarian source.

attributions.surface_quote: seven self-born primordial Gods, emanated from the trinitarian One

canonical_statement: The birth of stars and planets is a sequential process of ignition, kinetic movement, and eventual stabilization.

attributions.surface_quote: A laya-centre is lighted and awakened into life by the fires of another

canonical_statement: All cosmic matter originates from a singular, homogeneous substrate known as the World-Soul.

attributions.surface_quote: Born in the unfathomable depths of Space, out of the homogeneous Element called the World-Soul

canonical_statement: The evolution of cosmic matter is characterized by a struggle for existence against gravitational and destructive forces.

attributions.surface_quote: every nucleus of cosmic matter... begins life under the most hostile circumstances.

canonical_statement: The survival and trajectory of cosmic bodies are determined by their velocity and interaction with gravitational centers.

attributions.surface_quote: Others, moving in parabolic curves, generally escape destruction, owing to their velocity.

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies originate as homogeneous cosmic protoplasm that evolves through the accumulation of differentiated elements.

attributions.surface_quote: a lump of cosmic protoplasm... should rush from its bed... to strengthen its homogeneous organism

canonical_statement: The universe is structured by intelligent forces or entities that govern physical and climatic phenomena.

attributions.surface_quote: Four Mystical Entities... preside over the climates

canonical_statement: The physical universe is organized into a system of seven distinct spheres or planes of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The seven Lokas are elsewhere also called the Rings and the Circles.

canonical_statement: The fundamental substrate of the universe, Akasha, possesses the inherent properties of sound, which serves as the generative principle for subsequent elemental states.

attributions.surface_quote: Sound is the characteristic of Akasha: it generates Air.

canonical_statement: Planetary bodies function as receptacles and regulators of cosmic vitality, preventing structural dissolution through the management of electromagnetic forces.

attributions.surface_quote: The two Poles are said to be the store-houses of cosmic and terrestrial Vitality.

canonical_statement: The evolution of matter proceeds through seven distinct grades of transformation, moving from homogeneity to differentiation.

attributions.surface_quote: The seven fundamental transformations of the Globes or heavenly Spheres.

canonical_statement: The Earth exists as the fourth stage within a larger chain of planetary spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: The Small Wheel is our Chain of Spheres, and the Fourth Spoke is our Earth.

canonical_statement: The evolution of celestial bodies follows a hierarchical progression from primordial world-stuff to comets, stars, and finally planetary systems.

attributions.surface_quote: Curds become Wanderers; these become stars; and the stars... our sun and planets.

canonical_statement: The law of analogy dictates that the developmental processes of the universe are isomorphic to the developmental processes of human beings.

attributions.surface_quote: The law of analogy holds good for the worlds, as it does for man.

canonical_statement: Spiritual attainment is structured as a hierarchical progression of initiatory grades, with even the highest visible adepts remaining pupils to higher entities.

attributions.surface_quote: The Adept himself, the initiated candidate, becomes Chela to a higher Initiate.

canonical_statement: The temporal duration of the universe is cyclical, governed by vast, mathematically defined periods known as Kalpas and Yugas.

attributions.surface_quote: To calculate its age... we are not given the figures of the Great Kalpa.

canonical_statement: The evolution of human consciousness and form occurs in cyclical periods known as Manvantaras.

attributions.surface_quote: until the end of this minor Manvantara, the present Life-Cycle.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual intelligences incarnate into human forms to guide the development of future adepts.

attributions.surface_quote: highest Dhyanis... incarnated... to form the nursery for future human Adepts.

canonical_statement: The fundamental spiritual archetype of humanity remains constant while manifesting through changing historical forms.

attributions.surface_quote: It is he who changes form, yet remains ever the same.

canonical_statement: Spiritual intelligence can be transmitted or manifested through conscious will and meditative states rather than biological reproduction.

attributions.surface_quote: produced by Kriyashakti a progeny... the Sons of Will and Yoga.

canonical_statement: The physical world is a realm of illusion and matter that obscures the path to spiritual liberation.

attributions.surface_quote: limitless desert of Illusion and Matter called Earth-Life

canonical_statement: Advanced spiritual beings voluntarily remain in proximity to the material world to guide humanity toward enlightenment.

attributions.surface_quote: The Solitary Watcher remain at his selfchosen post

canonical_statement: Human civilization and intellectual advancement are the result of direct instruction from divine beings rather than purely biological evolution.

attributions.surface_quote: It is through these Sons of God that infant Humanity learned its first notions

canonical_statement: Spiritual knowledge and the fundamental laws of nature are transmitted through an unbroken lineage of initiates.

attributions.surface_quote: pupils of those incarnated Rishis and Devas... handed on their knowledge

canonical_statement: Ancient architectural mastery was derived from direct instruction by non-human entities known as the Sons of God.

attributions.surface_quote: descendants of those first taught by the Sons of God

canonical_statement: Historical architectural monuments were constructed using advanced, non-mechanical techniques that transcend modern empirical methods.

attributions.surface_quote: powers of machinery and a knowledge of mechanics to which modern skill is child's play

canonical_statement: The physical structure of sacred architecture is governed by divine proportions that reflect metaphysical perfection.

attributions.surface_quote: divine perfection of these architectural proportions

canonical_statement: Historical lineages of spiritual authority are derived from non-human or divine entities known as the Sons of God.

attributions.surface_quote: it is from them, these Brahmaputras, that the high Dvijas... claimed descent

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is not an inherent biological property but an external spark infused into the physical form by higher intelligences.

attributions.surface_quote: Lords of Wisdom... infused into him the spark of consciousness

canonical_statement: The structure of the manifested universe and the human form are isomorphic, reflecting a divine decadic or septenary pattern.

attributions.surface_quote: The Ten Sephiroth correspond to the Limbs of Man.

canonical_statement: The totality of the divine body consists of both concealed and manifested planes of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The seven manifested and the three concealed Limbs are the Body of the Deity.

canonical_statement: The physical world is a manifestation generated by the interaction of higher spiritual principles.

attributions.surface_quote: Malkuth is generated by the sixth Globe or Sephira, called Yezud.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of existence is the unification of all manifested parts into a single divine body.

attributions.surface_quote: When Matronitha is brought face to face with the King, all things become one body.

canonical_statement: Higher spiritual planes are inaccessible to the soul until it reaches a specific state of presence.

attributions.surface_quote: The first triad cannot be seen before the Soul stands in the presence of the Ancient.

canonical_statement: All existence is periodically reabsorbed into a singular, undifferentiated primordial substance.

attributions.surface_quote: all is reabsorbed once more into the One Element

canonical_statement: The duration of the active manifestation of the universe is equal to the duration of its dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: a Pralaya is equal in duration to a Manvantara

canonical_statement: The human constitution is composed of seven distinct principles.

attributions.surface_quote: These are our seven Principles.

canonical_statement: Ultimate spiritual liberation consists of an eternal state of union with the divine source.

attributions.surface_quote: they will ever be one with the Lord, and will enjoy an eternal Sabbath

attributions.surface_quote: Earth as the Fourth World, the lowest of the Chain, above which run six Globes.

canonical_statement: Humanity evolves through a series of seven distinct successive races.

attributions.surface_quote: This relates to the Seven Races, five of which have already appeared.

attributions.surface_quote: Out of Chaos the Earth was the sediment precipitated, and the Heavens the ethereal essences.

canonical_statement: Humanity occupies a mediating position between the terrestrial and the celestial realms.

attributions.surface_quote: Man appeared between the two [Earth and Heavens].

attributions.surface_quote: the doctrine of the septenary constitution of man

attributions.surface_quote: This Triad is disconnected with the lower Quaternary, as it disconnects itself always after death.

attributions.surface_quote: Without Manas... Atma-Buddhi is irrational on this plane and cannot act.

attributions.surface_quote: the number seven... was preeminent in all the secret systems

attributions.surface_quote: The Soul (or Ego) is a clothed light; and this light is triple.

attributions.surface_quote: The garment of the Soul is the rind of the Image.

canonical_statement: The astral body functions as a dualistic reflection of both moral good and evil.

attributions.surface_quote: The Image is double, because it reflects the good and the bad.

attributions.surface_quote: Manas is immortal, because after every new incarnation it adds to Atma-Buddhi.

canonical_statement: The highest spiritual principle is an eternal, unchanging ray that exists independent of human memory or progression.

attributions.surface_quote: Atma neither progresses, forgets, nor remembers. It does not belong to this plane.

canonical_statement: The collective soul exists simultaneously across multiple planes of reality, including the terrestrial.

attributions.surface_quote: The Soul lives on three planes, besides its fourth, the terrestrial sphere.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into distinct planes of existence corresponding to different states of the human soul.

attributions.surface_quote: These dwellings are: Earth, Kama Loka, and Devachan for the Higher Triad.

canonical_statement: The human constitution is a hierarchical series of nested 'moulds' or vehicles, where each layer shapes the one beneath it.

attributions.surface_quote: The Body is the mould of Nephesh; Nephesh the mould of Ruach.

canonical_statement: Individual personality is a temporary construct formed when the Monad incarnates into a physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: The Monad becomes a personal Ego when it incarnates.

attributions.surface_quote: The Astral is ever drawing Manas down into the sphere of material passions.

canonical_statement: A perfected human being possesses a higher ontological status than angelic entities.

attributions.surface_quote: A Perfect Man, a Man-God, is above all the Angels.

canonical_statement: Atma is formless and absolute, existing beyond the limitations of shape or body.

attributions.surface_quote: Atma is no body, or shape, or anything.

attributions.surface_quote: Successive attempts were being made by the law of evolution at the formation of universes.
